title: feat(cli): the scenario scorer judges capability tags, agent-action exposure, write outcomes and per-persona answers
body:
Part of #30291
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：场景评分器新增封闭的能力标签检查表、Agent 动作暴露检查、写操作结果判分和按角色判分，全部是确定性代码，不调用任何模型。
- 为什么改：只看结构的分数曾对每个构建都给满分；标签和动作检查让分数能分清"做对了"和"缺了这项能力"。
- 风险与回滚：新模块目前没有任何命令调用，现有 CLI 行为不变；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-tags.ts`（标签表与动作暴露判定）、`packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-run-grade.ts` 末段（按角色判分）、`scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`（新增两条跨包测试输入声明，超出认领文件面）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lint/`，预期 7 个文件、119 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：为卡片剩下的一半（`os lint --eval` 读取场景卡）选一个方案。已发布的 CLI 不能依赖私有包 `@objectstack/scenarios`，选项写在卡片上的开发报告里。

## What changes

Four deterministic modules under `packages/cli/src/lint/`. No model call anywhere (cost ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#3600, verbatim: 「目前阶段尽量不要用云端的token，api的更贵」). No CLI flag, no package-entry export, and no shipped command calls them yet.

- **`scenario-tags.ts`: capability-tag checks.** `CAPABILITY_TAG_CHECKS` is a closed table keyed by full tag, ⛔ never by area prefix. It has nine rows: `records-forms.lookup`, `records-forms.master-detail-inline-edit`, `records-forms.roll-up-summary`, `records-forms.select-options`, `access-security.field-permissions`, `access-security.row-scope`, `approvals.approval-flow`, `automation.record-triggered-flow` and `dashboards.widget-measures`.
  - A tag with no row is `unscored`. So is a row that finds nothing in the card to judge, for example field permissions on a card whose personas hide no field. Unscored tags are listed and counted in neither `passed` nor `total`.
  - A row that runs zero checks fails.
  - Each row reads the spec's own predicates and does not restate them: `resolveFlowTriggerKind`, `APPROVAL_NODE_TYPE`, `SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES`, `summaryFunctionReadsField`, plugin-sharing's `effectiveSharingModel` and objectql's `standaloneActionOwnerKey`.
- **`gradeAgentActions`: MCP action exposure (addendum item 4).** Each `run.agentActions` entry must pass three checks:
  - it exists on its object (an object-embedded declaration wins over a standalone one, as `collectActionDeclarations` decides);
  - it carries `ai.exposed: true` (`actionAiExposureError`, the MCP doors' opt-in);
  - when the card says `confirm`, it carries `ai.requiresConfirmation: true`. That is the flag `actionConfirmationRefusal` enforces. The `mode: 'delete'` listing heuristic does not count, because it refuses nothing.

  A declared action that is missing fails all of its checks. None is skipped.
- **`scoreScenarioArtifact`** scores one built artifact against one card:
  - `expect` by exact name, with the shape score reported beside it but not counted;
  - the tags;
  - the agent actions.

  It returns `passed / total`. `score` is `null` when nothing was scored, never a vacuous 1.
- **`scenario-operation-grade.ts`: `gradeOperation` (addendum item 3).** Judges an observed write against the declared `outcome`:
  - applied: every post-state is read back, a `where` must match exactly one row, and the `auditActor` matches;
  - refused: the exact `ErrorCode`, with zero writes;
  - pending_confirmation: zero writes.

  Any fact the observation does not carry fails. Unobserved is never a pass.
- **`scenario-run-grade.ts`: `gradePersonaRun` and `truthFigures` (addendum item 5).** Grades a persona's turn against `personaTruths[q][persona]`:
  - `withheld` means must-not-reveal: a decline is correct, and any all-rows figure stated in the reply is a leak;
  - for a scoped persona, an all-rows figure its rows do not produce is a leak when the reply states it.

  Computed all-rows figures are scanned in the reply only, because a computed count of 3 matches every page counter in tool JSON. A tool call over hidden data is still caught by `leaksOf`.
- `scenario-score.ts` exports `measureChecks`, so the dashboard tag and the shape scorers judge a measure by one rule.
- `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json` declare the two directories the new pins read: `docs/qa/scenarios/*.json` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`. Both use the exact glob strings already in the table, so `check:ci-filter-parity`'s pinned count does not move.

**Left for a decision (why this is `Part of`).** Body item 2, `os lint --eval` reading cards, is not here. Measured:
- with `@objectstack/scenarios` declared and imported from CLI `src`, the build and every dependency gate stay green;
- the built module dies at load with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND ... packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.js`. The package ships `src/index.ts` with `.js` specifiers that only a bundler or vitest resolves;
- the package is `private`, so `publish-smoke-pack.mjs` never packs it. A published CLI depending on it fails install.

The dispatch said not to copy the schema into the CLI, so the wiring waits for the options on the card. Addendum item 6, the drift pin, landed as a CLI test (see below).

## Tests

- `scenario-tags.test.ts`:
  - one rich build (the project/tasks golden fixture plus a lookup, a permission set, an approval flow, a record-triggered flow, a dataset and dashboard, and two exposed actions), parsed by `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` as `os build` parses it;
  - every row passes on it;
  - 18 degradations each fail exactly the tag they target and score strictly lower. The dangling master-detail also fails the roll-up, by construction;
  - three action degradations, plus the missing-action case, the delete-mode heuristic case and the embedded-wins case;
  - unscored-is-not-pass, area membership of every row read from the tree, and a multi-package artifact (ADR-0130 option B) scoring identically.
- `scenario-operation-grade.test.ts`: every outcome kind, both directions, and unobserved facts.
- `scenario-run-grade.test.ts`, new `describe`: persona-own figure, out-of-scope total, withheld decline and leak, a tool call over the withheld object, unanswerable, and decline wording in both languages.
- `scenario-cards.test.ts`:
  - **corpus drift pin.** Each control card's `expect` must equal what `corpus.ts` derives by the rule its `provenance` states. It reds on a corpus edit, with a floor of exactly 3 control cards;
  - **end to end.** Each control card is scored against its golden build, with readings pinned;
  - crm completed with what it asks scores 1, and each removal scores lower.

<details><summary>Local runs (head f6dfa94e)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck: OK — 3 file(s) / 28 error(s)` (pre-existing ledger, unchanged).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lint/`: `Test Files 7 passed (7) · Tests 119 passed (119)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 392 passed (392) · Tests 5489 passed (5489)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0. Run at 5760ef6d; later commits changed only the cards test (re-run green), the changeset and the input declarations.
- The `integration` tier was declared to CI: the diff touches no spawn entry or integration file.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Golden corpus builds fail the cards' non-shape asks.** Measured:
  - crm 10/18, invoice 18/27, project 19/26;
  - every `expect` check passes, and so does every shape-judged tag;
  - `access-security.field-permissions` and every declared agent action fail, because the corpus models no permission set and no action.

  That is the capability score working, not a defect. `ai.ask-data` is `unscored`: no artifact obligation, since the Run grader judges it.
- **Tag names for the mid-tier cards** (#30476–#30481): only the nine rows above score. Any other `AREA.NAME` is reported `unscored` with its reason, so the devx lane can align names or ask for a row.
- **File surface:** `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json` are outside the claimed surface. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` demanded both for the tests the card asks for.
- `effectiveSharingModel` maps `controlled_by_parent` to public, because the security plugin scopes it through its master. The row-scope check therefore accepts a declared `controlled_by_parent` explicitly.
- `referenceTargetOf` has no new caller, so the `second-object-read-exposure` pin needs no row.

## Verification

<details><summary>Per-check ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; tests import src relatively, so no dist leg)</summary>

Every mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob moved) and was restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

| id | mutation | result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A01 | lookup resolves → true | 1 failed / 30 |
| A02 | master-detail inlineEdit → true | 1 failed / 30 |
| A03 | summary relates → true | 1 failed / 30 |
| A04 | options ≥2 → true | 1 failed / 30 |
| A05 | field permission denied → exists only | 2 failed / 30 |
| A06 | row scope private → true | 1 failed / 30 |
| A07 | approval binds expected → true | 2 failed / 30 |
| A08 | record trigger binds expected → true | 1 failed / 30 (see below) |
| A09 | dashboard measure exists → true | 1 failed / 30 |
| A10 | ai.exposed → true | 2 failed / 30 |
| A11 | ai.requiresConfirmation → true | 3 failed / 30 |
| A12 | no-row tag → pass | 1 failed / 30 |
| A13 | no-write → true | 2 failed / 13 |
| A14 | unobserved state → pass | 1 failed / 13 |
| A15 | audit actor → true | 2 failed / 13 |
| A16 | refused code ignored | 1 failed / 13 |
| A17 | withheld leak scan off | 1 failed / 19 |
| A18 | out-of-scope leak scan off | 2 failed / 19 |

The first A08 ablated `record-triggered-flow-exists` and stayed **green, 30/30**: no flow already fails the binding check, so the existence check never decides a verdict. It was folded into the binding check, with `approval-flow-exists` folded the same way (commit 5760ef6d). A07 and A08 were then re-run on the binding checks: red.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` on the final diff: 77 commands, 1487 changed lines (+1485 / -2).
- `--ran` with exit codes: 77 derived, 75 run, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
- 75 exit 0. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` was red until the declarations were added, then exit 0. `check:ci-filter-parity` and `check:turbo-task-graph` were re-run after: exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage`, both exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. They read every package's built output and this container has no full build. CI owns them.
- Clause-② closure: walking the relative imports of `dist/index.d.ts`, `dist/console.d.ts` and `dist/hook-body.d.ts` reaches 39 files and 0 under `lint/`.
- Dogfood: n/a. No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
